phase_name: Nullable cwd schema field and threading (scope 5)

objectives.description: Add nullable cwd field to events-schema.json
Derive repo from cwd in events-query.sh, tolerant of null
Document cwd field and derived-repo behavior in events-format.md

deviations.description: Derive repo as basename of the git toplevel for that cwd
deviations.reason: Implemented as basename(cwd) via pure jq instead of a per-row `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` shell-out. The plan text itself flagged this as an example ("e.g."), and a per-row git invocation would be inconsistent with events-query.sh's existing native-jq streaming-filter design (no --slurp, no external process per line). In practice the cwd captured by the events hooks is already the invoking repo root, so basename(cwd) yields the same result with no added process-spawn cost per query.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — repo derived as basename(cwd) via jq, not a per-row git-toplevel shell-out; documented in events-format.md)*
